description: This file defines localization strings for the CKEditor plugin specializing in the 'fr-ca' (French-Canadian) language, specifically for the CodeMirror source plugin. It sets language-specific labels, shortcut descriptions, and other UI text for the plugin.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.plugins.setLang
methods.description: A method to set localization strings for a specific plugin and language in CKEditor.
